items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: By Meloni. That's right. Oh, Coat Street.

ctx.x: Tell me about that time, Harold, I gotta get this done, about that drink of whiskey. We were talking about on the way over here, about this man wanting you to drink with him.

In Popperville, Mississippi? Yeah. I'm talking about the man wanting to shoot me because I wouldn't take a drink. I thought I wouldn't drink any of them days. That's right. And the man who came behind the ball with his pistol took the gallon of whiskey away from the man and the pistol and give the gallon of whiskey to the band at Mississippi Con. What did he do? Give it to the band. The man took that pistol away from him. He said, if you don't take this drink of whiskey, I'm going to shoot you. You're going to…
I thought you said Coat. Coats.
